const a = ($json.headers || {}).authorization || '';
return [{ json: { token: a.replace(/^Bearer /, '').trim() } }];

parameters.query: select exists (select 1 from app_secrets where key = 'plugin_api_token' and value <> '') as configured, exists (select 1 from app_secrets where key = 'plugin_api_token' and value <> '' and value = $1) as ok

with b as (select $1::jsonb as j, $2::jsonb as ctx),
ins as (
  insert into triage_runs (client_id, window_start, window_end, spend, leads,
      appointments_ghl, appointments_meta_reported, divergence_ratio, cpl, cpba,
      lead_to_appt_rate, score, summary_md, raw)
  select (j->>'client_id')::uuid, (j->>'window_start')::date, (j->>'window_end')::date, (j->>'spend')::numeric, (j->>'leads')::numeric,
         (j->>'appointments_ghl')::int, (j->>'appointments_meta_reported')::int, (j->>'divergence_ratio')::numeric,
         (j->>'cpl')::numeric, (j->>'cpba')::numeric, (j->>'lead_to_appt_rate')::numeric, j->>'score', j->>'summary_md',
         case when jsonb_typeof(j->'raw') = 'object' then j->'raw' end
  from b
  returning id, run_at, client_id
),
aud as (
insert into audit_log (actor_type, actor_id, actor_email, action, entity_type, entity_id,
                       client_id, before, after, request_id, ip, user_agent, environment)
select 'plugin', (b.ctx->>'actor_id')::uuid, b.ctx->>'actor_email', 'triage_run.create', 'triage_run', ins.id::text,
       ins.client_id, null, jsonb_build_object('score', b.j->'score', 'window', jsonb_build_array(b.j->'window_start', b.j->'window_end')), null, (b.ctx->>'ip')::inet, b.ctx->>'user_agent', 'production'
from ins, b)
select (select json_build_object('id', id, 'run_at', run_at) from ins) as data
